text: This statue is very attractive and beautiful!The statue depicts the nativity scene of Mother Mary, Saint Joseph and baby Jesus very beautifully. This is an excellent choice for Christmas decoration or to create a peaceful and positive atmosphere at home.I really liked this statue. Highly recommended to everyone.
